description: Look up iTunes Store items (no Apple account or key) by ids — 1–200 trackId/collectionId/artistId values, e.g. from apple_itunes_search or an Apple Music link — or by one UPC/EAN (album), ISBN (book) or bundleId (app). With one item and entity, lists its related items: an album's songs (song), an artist's albums (album), a podcast's episodes (podcastEpisode, newest first; Apple serves at most 200 and fewer for some shows). Ids match Apple Music catalog ids; ids not found are listed. Episode ids cannot be looked up directly.

bundleId.description: An app bundle identifier, e.g. com.apple.Pages.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the store to use, e.g. us, gb, jp (default: APPLE_MUSIC_STOREFRONT, else us).

entity.description: List the item's related items of this type: song (an album's or artist's songs), album (an artist's albums), podcastEpisode (a podcast's episodes), musicVideo, ebook, audiobook, software, …

ids.description: 1–200 iTunes ids (trackId, collectionId or artistId). Only one id when entity is set.

items.description: A numeric iTunes / Apple Music id.

isbn.description: A book ISBN, 13-digit or 10-digit (hyphens allowed; ISBN-10 is converted).

limit.description: With entity: maximum related items to return (default 50, max 200; Apple serves only the first 200).

offset.description: With entity: zero-based index of the first related item (default 0, below 200); pass nextOffset from the previous page.

sort.description: With entity: "recent" returns the newest related items first.

upc.description: An album or video UPC/EAN (8–14 digits).

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact keeps ids (trackId/collectionId/artistId), names, type, release date, duration, track numbers, genre, explicitness, ratings, app bundleId/version, podcast feedUrl, episode audio URL and guid, shortDescription and the store link; it drops artwork, 30-second previews, prices (except formattedPrice), censored-name copies and long descriptions. full returns Apple's records verbatim.

name: apple_itunes_lookup
title: Look up iTunes Store items by id, UPC, ISBN or bundle id
